business_problem: Hanwha needed to unify scattered operational data across divisions so it could automate reporting, support scenario analysis, and make scheduling and planning more data driven.
solution_summary: Hanwha Corporation uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Databricks SQL, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog to support integrated enterprise data platform for manufacturing and construction. Hanwha needed to unify scattered operational data across divisions so it could automate reporting, support scenario analysis, and make scheduling and planning more data driven. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Delta Lake, governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform, and delivers outputs through Databricks SQL. Legacy operational and analytics data are consolidated into Delta Lake; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Databricks SQL. The case study reports Powering efficient manufacturing worldwide 97%+, Reduction in manual reporting time 90%+, and 97%+, showing measurable improvement after the rollout.
business_outcome: Hanwha Corporation reported Powering efficient manufacturing worldwide 97%+, Reduction in manual reporting time 90%+, and 97%+, improving integrated enterprise data platform for manufacturing and construction with measurable gains in productivity improvement, speed to market, and scalability.
architecture_clues: Centralized governance and lineage are enforced through Unity Catalog.
